diagram.manim_description: Canvas 16 by 9 units on a plain BG (#FFFFFF) background, origin at the centre, x to the right, y up (1 unit = 120 px on a 1920-px-wide render). Draw four tilted square dot lattices (each is an n by n array of dots turned by 45 degrees, so a corner points up), for n = 1, 2, 3, 4, left to right, with their bottom dots on the same line y = -1.2. Dots are filled INK, radius 0.12. Half-step h = 0.65. Diamond n has 2n-1 rows of dots; row t from the top has min(t, 2n-t) dots, row t sits at y = -1.2 + (2n-1-t) * 0.65, and the q-th dot of a row with m dots (q = 0 to m-1) sits at x = cx + (2q - (m-1)) * 0.65. Total dots 1, 4, 9, 16. Join every dot to each dot that is one row above or one row below it and 0.65 to the left or right, with INK lines of stroke 2 px, so each diamond is a lattice of small tilted squares (diamond 1 has no line, diamond 2 has 4 lines, diamond 3 has 12 lines, diamond 4 has 24 lines). Labels in INK, text height 0.38, centred under each diamond: first line at y = -2.1, second line at y = -2.8. Diamond 1: '1' on the first line only. Diamond 2: '1+2+1' then '= 4'.
